mapper.sql: simple_password_verification_id AS simplePasswordVerificationId, member_id AS memberId, verification_code_hash AS verificationCodeHash, verification_status AS verificationStatus, failed_attempt_count AS failedAttemptCount, verification_code_expires_at AS verificationCodeExpiresAt, change_token_hash AS changeTokenHash, change_token_expires_at AS changeTokenExpiresAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM simple_password_verification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, simple_password_verification_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM simple_password_verification WHERE change_token_hash = #{changeTokenHash} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE simple_password_verification SET verification_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND verification_status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED') AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simple_password_verification ( member_id, verification_code_hash, verification_status, failed_attempt_count, verification_code_expires_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{verificationCodeHash}, #{verificationStatus}, #{failedAttemptCount}, #{verificationCodeExpiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE simple_password_verification SET failed_attempt_count = failed_attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE simple_password_verification_id = #{simplePasswordVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE simple_password_verification SET verification_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE simple_password_verification_id = #{simplePasswordVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE simple_password_verification SET verification_status = 'VERIFIED', change_token_hash = #{changeTokenHash}, change_token_expires_at = #{changeTokenExpiresAt}, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE simple_password_verification_id = #{simplePasswordVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING' AND verification_code_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE simple_password_verification SET verification_status = 'USED', used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE simple_password_verification_id = #{simplePasswordVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND change_token_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND used_at IS NULL
